description: Run multiple analyses across multiple entry files in one call. Returns per-entry results plus aggregate summary (total components, highest complexity, shared contexts). Ideal for monorepos and multi-entry apps.

analyses.description: Which analyses to run on each entry

entries.description: Array of entry files to analyze

entryFile.description: Absolute path to an entry React component file

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth for tree traversal. Default: unlimited

name: batch_analysis
